load_model_flash_attention: load a gpt-oss causal language model with flash attention kernels and auto device mapping
create_tokenizer_chat_prompt: create a chat prompt from messages using the gpt-oss tokenizer apply_chat_template method
generate_model_response: generate a text response from the gpt-oss model given a tokenized chat prompt and generation config
decode_model_output: decode the model's generated token output into a readable string skipping special tokens
configure_generation_params: configure generation parameters like max_new_tokens using transformers GenerationConfig
